name: Teysa Karlov
title: Orzhov Negotiator
summary: A resourceful Orzhov leader who navigated the chaos following the first Guildpact's destruction.
biography: Teysa worked within the Orzhov Syndicate's world of contracts, debts, and political leverage.
During the struggles that followed the broken Guildpact she allied with Agrus Kos to confront threats to Ravnica's future.

Teysa's legal expertise mattered after Agrus Kos exposed the paradox that destroyed the old magical Guildpact. As the factions contended with violence and political breakdown, she became an important negotiator rather than a claimant to the power of an ancient parun.

The Ravnica retrospective credits Teysa with drafting a new, nonmagical agreement between the guilds. This did not restore the previous enchantment or force the guildmasters to keep their promises: the city still had to manage competing interests through politics and enforcement.

Her historical role therefore connects the end of the original trilogy to the later history of guild law. It should not be confused with Jace Beleren's subsequent status as the Living Guildpact, which arose in a different era.
